$comment: The documents users can draft, read by the backend (AI chat) and the frontend (preview and PDF). Each document is a Cover Page built from `fields`, plus the Common Paper Standard Terms in `standardTerms`. Field kinds: text, longtext, date (blank means today), years (whole years, 1-99) and choice. A choice option's text may embed a years field as {key}; that field is then shown only there. Fields that share a `section` are shown under one heading. Optional fields show `emptyText` when blank. `guidance` tells the AI assistant what the field holds.
